title: Amazon Seller Central–NetSuite Sync for CPG Brands: Orders, Fees, and Settlement Evidence
summary: Amazon orders, fees and settlement events reach NetSuite as read-only evidence, so finance can itemize the gap between gross sales and the deposit.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


Use Amazon Seller Central data as marketplace evidence for NetSuite reconciliation. Preserve separate identities for orders, lines, financial events, and settlement periods so finance can explain the difference between gross sales and deposited cash. The Amazon sync connector has read-only access; a reconciliation design must not assume it can change marketplace orders or issue refunds.


Explore the complete[consumer packaged goods integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/cpg) for the systems and processes around this guide.
